ENGLAND 1933---Winning Team
Arthur Penny (second from right, front row) was 9th and Bert Footer (far left second row ) was 4th. The individual winner was Jack Holden (centre front ).

Bert Footer leads Arthur Penny and Arthur Allum during the Club '10' of 1933. They finished in that order with times of 57:31,58:26,and 60:19. Cecil Mains was 4th, Tom Carter 5th and Harry Shields 6th.

This is thought to be the start of the Club '10' of 1926. Of the 11 starters, 9 finished. Winner was the smartly turned-out Bert Footer. (3rd from right) alongside of whom is the bespectacled Wally Bayliss who was to become our President, but probably retired from this race. Runner up to Footer was Micky Pyer (extreme left) who won in 1923 and 1924; with George Still (extreme right) 3rd. A.E. Smith (second from left) was 5th and J.G. Flatt (fourth from left) 6th.
THE GREATER ROAD RUNNER (G. CALIFORNIANUS) / THE LESSER ROAD RUNNER (G. AFFINIS)

MICKY PYER (22), competing in a 2 miles team race against Ashcombe AC and TVH in 1924. Leading is H.W. Ellsey (Ashcombe) later to become a Vice President of Belgrave. No. 20 in the rear is Bert Footer.

Micky Pyer (extreme left) lines up at the start of the Belgrave 10 mile C.C. Championship in 1926. Having won the title in 1923 and 1924, this time he had to give way to his captain Bert Footer.
Left to right: A.D.Pyer, A.E.Smith, -, J.G.Flatt, -, -, -, -, H.E.Footer, W.L.Bayliss, G.Still.
Below: 28th February 1925 and the Southern Championships at Beaconsfield. Ken, wearing no. 29, chases his captain Bert. Footer, no. 26. They finished 103rd and 23rd respectively on this occasion.

Above: The 1925 Club Championships at Battersea Park. The final of the 1 mile championship for the Garnet Cup. Left to right: H.E.Footer, K.O'Kell, A.D.Pyer, G.J.Rees, W.D.Pritchard and F.L.Buckingham. The winner was Ken, in 4:41.2, from Buckingham and Footer. Just look at the crowds!
